items: Self-test (Settings › Diagnostics, or run the app with --selftest): checks what works on this PC with Windows error codes, ready to copy into a support message.
Local diagnostics log and crash recording; interface errors are caught instead of freezing silently.
The window recovers if its page process crashes, long lists are capped for speed, and a second click during a running task is ignored.
Device problems: known-issue knowledge base (online-updatable) gives each failing device a specific diagnosis, a safe repair plan and a clear result; decodes any Windows failure status.
Complete step-by-step 'What happened' log and a Details window with the full log.
Fix all problems at once, copy diagnostic details for support, and an optional read-only device check at start.
What's new and Help pages inside the app.
Update channel (stable or beta) and one-click roll back to the previous version.
The administrator helper now also covers Clean items that need administrator rights.
If the new interface cannot start (missing WebView2 runtime) Feather explains why and offers the Microsoft download page.
Drivers: new Problems tab explains why a device cannot start (problem code, Windows failure status, driver service, Kernel-PnP log) and offers automatic and manual fixes.
Light / dark / follow-Windows theme.
Beta features switch (Store app removal, Windows update uninstall, administrator helper).
Journal entries now record a type and how to undo.
Optional administrator helper: one permission prompt instead of restarting Feather.
Progress and results appear in a status bar with Cancel for scans.
More reliable registry deletes and exact failure reasons.
Dashboard: device model, Windows Update status, optional live activity, storage trend, review list.
Microsoft Store apps and Windows updates in the uninstaller; startup boot impact.
License verification, SBOM, privacy policy.
Startup and Services show a Recommendation column (safe to disable?) from an online-updatable list.
Administrator prompts instead of silent failures; Safe Mode support.
Drivers: problem codes, installed-vs-proposed comparison, one-at-a-time install.
Privacy page and Troubleshoot page with redacted reports.
Update check at launch.
Quarantine, Recovery page, dry-run previews, exclusions and ignored findings.
Completely new interface.
